description: This file defines a store for managing shopping cart state in a Vue.js application using Pinia. It includes reactive state variables, computed properties for deriving data, and methods for manipulating the cart items such as adding, removing, updating quantities, clearing the cart, and toggling the cart display.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds a product to the cart or increases its quantity if it already exists.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes an item from the cart based on the product ID.

methods.name: updateQuantity
methods.description: Updates the quantity of an existing cart item; removes the item if the quantity is less than or equal to zero.

methods.name: function clearCart() { clearCart
methods.description: Removes all items from the cart.

methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the cart drawer.
